Download a CSV from football-data.co.uk

Source: R/data_download.R
download_fd_csv.Rd

Downloads match data for a single league and season. Files are cached locally to avoid repeated downloads.

Usage

download_fd_csv(
  league_code,
  season,
  cache_dir = here::here("inst", "extdata", "raw"),
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

league_code

Character. League code (e.g. "E0").

season

Character. 4-digit season code (e.g. "2324").

cache_dir

Character. Directory to store downloaded CSVs. Defaults to inst/extdata/raw.

overwrite

Logical. Re-download even if cached? Default FALSE.

Value

Character path to the downloaded CSV file (invisibly).

See also
